## 15. Research Integrity Statement

Evidence, interpretation, recommendation, and decision are separated in this RDR. Hermes may recommend, but Paul Austin retains final approval authority for governance, release promotion, and material risk acceptance. No live trading, broker connectivity, or paper-trading API is authorised by this RDR.
